programs.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Whitaker's Chocolates and Heck! Sausages"
programs.desc: Lord Prescott visits Whitaker’s chocolate factory to explore large-scale chocolate making, from factory lines to expert tasting and the company’s rich history. He then heads to HECK! Sausages in North Yorkshire, where he attempts to create his own custom recipe—the Hull banger.

programs.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Wensleydale Cheese and Mowbray Pork Pies"
programs.sub_title: Wensleydale Cheese and Mowbray Pork Pies
programs.desc: At the Wensleydale Creamery, Lord Prescott joins master cheesemakers to follow the production of the famous Yorkshire Wensleydale cheese, learning the art of cheese-tasting along the way. His next stop is Mowbray Pork Pies, where he experiences the high-speed world of pie production.

programs.title: Breakthrough S1 - "The Earliest Americans"
programs.desc: New evidence suggets humans arrived in North America far earlier than previously thoughtm and that they may have traveled along paths now buried deep beneath the sea.

programs.title: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of Mr. Kipling Cakes"
programs.desc: Uncover the secrets of what it takes to make up to 5 million cakes a day, including French Fancies, Angel Slices and Bramley Apple Pies. Meet the engineers who keep the machines running 24/7, the workers making all the cakes, and the operators who spend their days with state-of-the-art robots.

programs.title: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of Kellogg's Cereals"
programs.desc: In Kellogg’s first factory in Europe, built in the 1930s in Trafford Park, Manchester, we meet the people who flake the corn and puff the rice, the tasters who test, and the robots and hi-tech machines that help keep the boxes rolling out day and night.

programs.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Historic House"
programs.desc: A family in Calgary call in a team of house truckers to move a historic colonial house to help give them – and their five children – more living space.
